original_pre_race_assessment.raw_reasoning:
National Pride and High Calibre won their latest nurseries and receive 2 lb and 3 lb respectively. Capricious Star was second here yesterday and receives 6 lb. Happy Love makes his handicap and all-weather debut off 80.

Happy Love was second by 0.75 and 1 length in two turf novices across 7f–1m, giving his opening mark and nursery progression a credible route. He could control a small field and improve again. National Pride and High Calibre have been raised after their wins.

Two rivals have demonstrated nursery-winning form on lower carried weights, and a third provides recent form at this track. Their cases are strong enough to oppose Happy Love even though his two close novice seconds give him a plausible winning chance.

Won 7f Chelmsford Polytrack nursery by 1.25 lengths from 73, now 78 and receives 2 lb; extends to 1m142y on Tapeta. Won 9f Newmarket turf nursery by 3.5 lengths off 71 in a ten-runner field, now 77 and receives 3 lb; surface transfer and a 6 lb rise matter. Second by 1 length over 1m1½f here yesterday on handicap debut; receives 6 lb; overnight turnaround and stronger class temper it.

post_race_observations.analysis: Happy Love was second by a neck to original rank 1 National Pride. High Calibre, rank 2, led and was third, three quarters of a length behind Happy Love. National Pride challenged in the final furlong and led inside the final 110 yards. Happy Love remained competitive throughout on his handicap and all-weather debut. This supports the specific nursery-form and staying case for National Pride, with no isolated causal evidence for the 2 lb weight difference. Capricious Star, rank 3, was a non-runner, removing the course-form route. The three-runner race was decided narrowly.
post_race_observations.withdrawal_observation: Capricious Star was an official non-runner. First verified in this audit from the settled result. No contemporaneous pre-off warning was established.
